decision.reasoning_trace: Selected products based on highest rating, relevance to 'Toothbrushes' category, and customer reviews indicating good quality and effectiveness. Priority given to electric toothbrushes with advanced features like rechargeability and multiple modes. Oral-B Pro-Health Cross Action Advanced Toothbrush was chosen as the final product due to its high rating, numerous positive reviews, and Oral-B's reputation as a trusted brand in oral care.
